title: On skew ultralimits and their applications in ultrafilter theory
summary: We define a special version of the ultralimit, called the skewed ultralimit. Using this tool, we show that the set of ultrafilter types in the $C$-equivalence class of a Ramsey ultrafilter $\mathfrak u\in βω$ with the Rudin-Keisler order is isomorphic to the ultrapower of $(ω, \leq)$.
